build_feature_selector: build a feature selector class inheriting from SelectorMixin with a custom _get_support_mask method
test_get_support: test the SelectorMixin.get_support method to retrieve a boolean mask or integer indices of selected features
refactor_transform: refactor the SelectorMixin.transform method to reduce input data to selected features with sparse and dataframe support
review_inverse_transform: review the SelectorMixin.inverse_transform method to reverse feature selection by inserting zero columns back
summarize_get_feature_importances: summarize the _get_feature_importances function that retrieves and aggregates feature importances from an estimator
